definitions.explanation: Money spent on transportation, such as train fares, bus fares, or taxi costs.

examples.japanese: {交通費|こうつうひ}は{会社|かいしゃ}が{払|はら}ってくれる。
examples.english: The company pays for transportation expenses.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}の{交通費|こうつうひ}は{約|やく}1{万円|まんえん}です。
examples.english: My monthly transportation costs are about 10,000 yen.

examples.japanese: {面接|めんせつ}に{行|い}く{交通費|こうつうひ}を{請求|せいきゅう}できますか。
examples.english: Can I claim transportation expenses for going to the interview?

notes:
{交通費|こうつうひ} combines {交通|こうつう} (transportation) + {費|ひ} (expense/cost).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {交通費|こうつうひ}を{払|はら}う (to pay transportation costs)
- {交通費|こうつうひ}を{支給|しきゅう}する (to provide transportation allowance)
- {交通費|こうつうひ}{込|こ}み (transportation included)

RELATED ～費 COMPOUNDS:
- {食費|しょくひ} (food expenses)
- {光熱費|こうねつひ} (utility costs)
- {生活費|せいかつひ} (living expenses)
- {医療費|いりょうひ} (medical expenses)

USAGE NOTES:
- In Japan, many companies provide 交通費 as part of employee benefits
- Often specified separately in job listings
